title: Styled Components
description: Learn CSS-in-JS styling with styled-components library for dynamic, component-scoped styles.

data.text: **Styled Components** is a CSS-in-JS library that lets you write actual CSS in your JavaScript. It generates unique class names and supports dynamic styling based on props.

data.title: Styled Component
Extending
Theme

data.text: Styled components can change based on props, making them highly reusable. You can access props inside the template literal to conditionally apply styles.

data.title: Dynamic Props
data.content: Changing styles based on component props

data.title: Why Styled Components?
items: **Scoped styles** - Class names are auto-generated, preventing conflicts
**Dynamic styling** - Change styles based on props or theme
**Easy maintenance** - Styles live next to the component
**Theming** - Share design tokens across the app

data.title: Dynamic Styling
data.text: Styled components can change based on props, making them highly reusable and adaptable.

terms.definition: A styling approach where CSS is written inside JavaScript files.

A component that provides theme values to all styled components in the tree.

data.takeaway: Styled components offer powerful, dynamic styling.
